exact_event_inclusion_contract.prefix: Fix all original and auxiliary source oracles after auxiliary roots/finals are bound, before constraint row challenges. Source authentication/extraction belongs to a separate ideal-oracle reduction.
exact_event_inclusion_contract.tensor: For every Boolean joint parameter tuple b and domain x, F(x,b) = sum_j beta_j(b)*source_j(project_j(x)); source_j and projections are fixed at prefix. beta includes rowpoint, final-layer ru/rv/gamma and PCS u blocks in deterministic coordinate order.
exact_event_inclusion_contract.identity: Prove tensorEvaluate(q,F,z,x) equals the actual verifier initial virtual source oracle for every correctly shaped accepted transcript with selected challenges z. This requires full heterogeneous branches and sparse lift mapping; affine degrees alone are insufficient.
exact_event_inclusion_contract.checked_fold_inclusion: For a transcript outside the existing fold extraction-bad transitions, accepted queries are either bounded by the known seed survival term or its stage-0 oracle has a degree<D candidate with agreement >=T. Discarding residual yields tensorTerminalSuccess(F,z). This needs the literal binding identity, not a new arbitrary verifier-soundness assumption.
exact_event_inclusion_contract.far_event: no tensorRepresentative(F) AND accepted complete transcript. With the identity and causal sampling reduction, it lies in tensor terminal success OR fold extraction bad OR surviving inconsistent queries.
exact_event_inclusion_contract.budget_form: q*max(N,2)/|S| + sum_stage max(N_stage,2)/|S| + ((T-1)/N)^queries, for the FAR branch only, once all named identities/causal embeddings are proved. This is a symbolic contract, not a certified current implementation bound.
exact_event_inclusion_contract.causal_sampling: Unused randomness can be indexed by semantic phase/round and fixed as an auxiliary tape. Selected rowpoint, final-layer GKR and PCS coordinates must each be fresh uniform draws; aborts count as rejection. Variable-depth branches must not change selected coordinate dimensions or allow rejection/resampling. Establish a prefix-preserving embedding into a fixed product tape before applying tensor_far_success_count.
exact_event_inclusion_contract.near_event: A universal representative must determine a single source-lane tuple before row challenges. Universal slot/row separation proves at most one represented source table; extraction existence, sparse-lift image and full GKR/zerocheck reductions remain.

minimal_fixed_envelope.change: New profile/config pins input_log=m. layer_circuit sets input_size=2^m after allocating constants and requires cursor+1<=2^m. Private_capacity and slot offsets unchanged; final zero slot is 2^m-1. All final GKR instances use exactly 2m row challenges.
minimal_fixed_envelope.bound: Use trusted static maximum live-constant count derived from unoptimized AIR terminal program, or a declared checked resource cap. m must satisfy 2^m >= private_capacity+Cmax+1 for completeness. Runtime constant folding and all other layer topology can remain.
minimal_fixed_envelope.why_only_input: Universal source coefficients depend on final input eq weights, private slot positions and terminal rowpoints; intermediate circuit topology affects adversarial proof messages but not that fixed family.
minimal_fixed_envelope.cost: Increasing input_log by delta adds 2*delta final-layer quadratic rounds, 6*delta extension elements (96*delta raw bytes for current Ext4), and 2*delta tensor coordinates. Honest final-input buffer and MLE work grow with 2^m; no runtime estimate claimed.

additional_obstructions: Source roots are fixed but arbitrary Merkle words need not be low-degree or valid full RS encodings. Honest PackedSourceExecution does not discharge this.

Common-domain interpolation can produce degree<D candidates outside an original branch sparse-lift image; a separate adversarial image-recovery/uniqueness theorem is required before assigning original table dimensions.
Current GKR input_size depends on live constant count after challenge-dependent constant folding/deduplication, so it is not currently one fixed-dimensional joint tensor.
Near-branch soundness must use one representative before row challenges, not a separate family fixed only after GKR.
